quotes.text: We don't want China to have that market and that control. Because then the materials like TikTok, they send our kids and talk about our nation. So we need to make sure that the U.S. has guidelines. We don't need our adversaries leading that.

Hardworking Americans shouldn't pay for data centers electricity bill. My House colleagues and I just passed the Ratepayer Protection Act to protect Alabamians while ensuring America stays ahead of our adversaries and remains the global leader in technological innovation.

I think the president is right in his approach that we cannot let China get upper hand because the learning curve on that thing, the technology, the advancements, it's almost straight up. In other words, whoever has the lead, it's hard to catch up.

We can put guardrails on it in some way to make sure that we know what AI is doing. We sit down with the experts, those of us here who are making those decisions, but at the same time, we don't need to hinder the development of technology that will certainly be at play in the next few years and is moving rapidly.

I think it is a little hyperbolic. Again, we got to get experts up here because there are people that are saying they're concerned about that. I don't know that I necessarily buy into that 100%. You know, I think that certainly, like I said, we need guardrails.
